For q=2 mod3, the projection point-count bijection plus quadratic line splitting forces Picard eigenvalue multiplicities 4 and 3. Standard Weil cohomology gives all extension point counts and the zeta factors. Executable checker verifies all smooth parameters in six prime fields and independently counts quadratic-extension points for p=5,7. No finite computation is used as an infinite proof.
